runtime_contract: getStreams(tmdbId, mediaType, season, episode) plus global SCRAPER_ID, SCRAPER_SETTINGS and TV-only TMDB_API_KEY

runtime_capabilities.stream_title_projection: LocalScraperResult title/name/quality retained; toStream appends quality only when not already present
runtime_capabilities.stream_description_projection: LocalScraperResult has no description field; Stream.description is projected from size
runtime_capabilities.stream_badges_projection: provider badgeIds/displayBadges are not parsed; StreamBadgeRules re-matches textual Stream fields

manifest_platform_filtering.consequence: Do not rely on manifest platform fields to hide an unsafe provider from NuvioTV; the provider output itself must be strict-media safe or globally disabled.

semantic_changes_reviewed: PluginRuntime still calls positional getStreams(tmdbId, mediaType, season, episode), injects SCRAPER_ID/SCRAPER_SETTINGS/TMDB_API_KEY and preserves Proxy.NO_PROXY + IPv4FirstDns transport semantics
PluginRuntime still exposes 30-second HTTP timeouts and a 60-second plugin runtime timeout; the outer scraper safety budget remains 120 seconds

Subtitle projection changed additively: the current Subtitle model carries Map<String,String>? headers and those subtitle-specific headers must survive provider projection/sanitization independently from the main stream headers
TextEncoder/TextDecoder and WebAssembly remain absent from the current TV PluginRuntime
audit.runtime_reproof_reason: TV subtitle result projection changed after the previous audited ref; source audit is complete but a fresh Android-TV Native Lab must prove the current result path before the contract is considered fully re-proven.

notes: NuvioTV provider compatibility is a distinct runtime family from Nuvio Mobile and Nuvio Desktop.
The source_ref is the exact official NuvioTV commit most recently source-audited against this contract.
NuvioTV injects TMDB_API_KEY into the plugin runtime; Mobile/Desktop do not expose that runtime global.
Provider extraction uses positional getStreams and preserves returned URL/header material; main playback networking consumes behaviorHints/proxyHeaders.
Subtitle entries now preserve their own headers separately from the main stream headers.
NuvioTV parses supportedPlatforms/disabledPlatforms in the manifest model but PluginManager does not apply those fields when building enabled scrapers.
A zero-stream result is not by itself proof of incompatibility.
Providers blocked on every Mobile/Desktop runtime but still enabled in the shared manifest must sanitize all NuvioTV-returned URLs against real media payloads.
Promoted direct-media wrappers require strict HLS, DASH or real container evidence.
Cross-work infinite loading that clears immediately after restarting NuvioTV is client lifecycle/executor exhaustion evidence, not provider disablement proof.
NuvioTV does not expose TextEncoder/TextDecoder or WebAssembly from PluginRuntime.
